current.text: Phoenix wants Green to be its starting point guard and bring the ball up.
Josh thinks Booker will still run the offense, even with Green listed at point guard.
He is expected to start next to Booker, Brooks and Bridges. Gillespie is expected to come off the bench.
His low minutes last season came from minutes limits, not his role. He should play 30 to 33 minutes and get more shots this season.
His usage should drop from 32% to about 28-29%. Booker, Brooks, Bridges and Gillespie all want touches, and the four starters should take most of the minutes and usage.
Experts project about 20 points and two threes a game. One expert adds about four rebounds and four assists.
His steals jump last season was luck: he turned an unusually high share of deflections (80%) into steals. The steals should not hold.
His FT% (75%) and 3P% (31%) from last season should probably go back up.
Last season's hamstring problem is not a concern for this season.
Experts rank him around 100 to 120 in category leagues. One expert says a rank of 124 is too low, and Josh drafted him near his Yahoo ADP of 102.

durable.text: He had three hamstring strains in 2025-26. He had never been hurt before that season.
He is a high-volume shooter. His usage was 32% when he played last season.
He is a weak passer. He has never shown point guard skills, and experts do not trust his playmaking.
He plays downhill but is not efficient around the rim. His low FG% on heavy volume clearly hurts a team's FG%.
His turnovers are high for his position.
He can score 20 points a game with over two threes, and scorers at that level are hard to find.
He is worth more in points leagues than in category leagues. 9-cat formulas penalize his poor efficiency.
He is not a great player or a star.

tags.name: FG% liability
tags.detail: about 42% FG on 17 to 19 attempts, not efficient at the rim

tags.name: injury prone
tags.detail: three hamstring strains in 2025-26; one expert says it is not a concern now

note: At about 2 USD on Yahoo and ESPN (ranks 122 and 103), he costs far less than the 9 USD he went for in our league last season. In a 144-player draft he is a cheap late scorer for 3PM and PTS, but he fits mainly punt FG% builds, and punt TO builds also lose little with him. Early in the season, check whether he gets 30+ minutes and really runs the point, and whether his FT% recovers toward 79% while his steals drop.
